name: Yuri
source:
Standing in the cape's meadow is a girl with an ethereal aura about her.  
She claims to have met the protagonist in their childhood and says she has been waiting for him all this time.  
For some reasons, she always walks around barefoot.  
(Spoilers below)  
[spoiler]In truth, she was actually deceased long ago. The person she truly awaited was not the protagonist, but his father.  
After learning the whole truth and fulfilling her long-held wish,  
she bade farewell to the protagonist at her beloved cape and dissipated into the air.[/spoiler]
